Spain-based high‑performance computing firm Multiverse Computing achieved unicorn status after raising €500 million in a Series C round that valued the company at roughly €1.5 billion. The funding, part of the EU’s startup ecosystem, brings additional capital for expanding its software services and infrastructure offerings. With this valuation increase, Multiverse stands as one of Spain’s most valuable tech startups.
